{{Youmay|the type of flower|[[Rose Tico]], a member of the [[Resistance]]}}
The '''rose''' was a type of [[Flower/Legends|flower]]. It was occasionally used in wedding bouquets.<ref name="Queen of the Empire">''[[Queen of the Empire]]''</ref>

Types of roses included:
*[[Ithorian rose/Legends|Ithorian rose]]<ref name="Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope">''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]''</ref>
*[[Jade rose]]<ref>[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>
*[[Malreaux rose]]<ref name="Yoda: Dark Rendezvous">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>
*[[Tarisian Rose|Tarisian rose]]<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
*A type of purple rose native to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]<ref name="Queen of the Empire" />
